listing.name: DKC3Recomp
listing.summary: Native Donkey Kong Country 3 recompilation. This Windows build has a known game-logic failure during startup; Portcove has not confirmed gameplay.
listing.original_game_title: Donkey Kong Country 3: Dixie Kong's Double Trouble!

steps.title: Choose the setup for your system
steps.instruction: On Windows, select your own headerless North American English/French DKC3 ROM in Portcove and review the Windows installation. On Apple Silicon, use the upstream Mac app and its launcher.

steps.title: Open the upstream Mac app
steps.instruction: On an Apple Silicon Mac with macOS 26 or later, download the official Mac arm64 ZIP from DKC3Recomp Releases. Extract it in Finder and keep DKC3Recomp.app intact in a permanent folder. Open the app directly. The reviewed alpha bundle is ad-hoc signed.

steps.title: Select your original ROM
steps.instruction: In the app’s launcher, select your own unmodified headerless North American English/French Donkey Kong Country 3 ROM. Keep that file in place. The launcher uses the original at its selected location.

steps.title: Keep your Mac profile before updating
steps.instruction: Quit the app and back up ~/Library/Application Support/Flat2VR/DKC3Recomp, including its saves folder, before replacing the app yourself. If you set DKC3_USER_DIR or use DKC3_PORTABLE, back up the actual selected location. Keep build-specific states with the app version that created them.

warnings: The Mac app is an upstream-managed alpha. Use its own launcher and keep its profile separate from the Windows setup.

references.title: Reviewed Mac package
references.instruction: The v0.0.6 release reuses the exact v0.0.4 Mac bundle. See https://github.com/elliotttate/DKC3Recomp/releases/tag/v0.0.6 for the publisher’s package and platform notes.

source_requirements.label: Donkey Kong Country 3 (North America, En/Fr) headerless SNES source

presentation.manual_preparation: Select your own headerless North American English/French DKC3 .sfc. Portcove installs the checked Windows package and manages its default local saves separately from existing external copies. This build needs a short installation folder using basic Latin characters; original files can stay where they are. The reviewed v0.0.6 build had a game-logic failure during startup; later releases have not been observed running here. Gameplay, visual correctness and save/load remain unqualified.
